# provenance

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:provenance`](gmeow-provenance.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/provenance>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/provenance`](../../slices/provenance.md)

A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of a resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.
